powershell7.title: PowerShell 7 is recommended
powershell7.fallbackAvailable: pwsh.exe was not detected. WebCodex will keep using Windows PowerShell 5.1 as a compatibility fallback, so setup is not blocked. After PowerShell 7 is installed, newly started Runners prefer pwsh.exe by default.
powershell7.fallbackUnavailable: Neither pwsh.exe nor the Windows PowerShell compatibility fallback was detected. Install PowerShell 7 before starting the local Runner.
powershell7.restartHint: If a new installation is still not detected, fully quit and reopen WebCodex to refresh its process environment.

error.enrollmentAction: Check the Server and enrollment details, then retry.

error.processAction: Check Activity and confirm the WebCodex programs can run, then retry.
error.contractTitle: Desktop and WebCodex protocols do not match
error.contractAction: Make sure Desktop and all three WebCodex programs come from the same source revision.
error.topologyTitle: This operation is not supported by the current runtime topology
error.topologyAction: Set up this computer as a main node, or manage external access on the remote Server.
error.operationBusyTitle: Another Desktop operation is still running
error.operationBusyAction: Wait for the current operation to finish, or stop it first.
error.operationStaleAction: Refresh state before stopping the operation you currently observe.
error.operationCancelledAction: Observe the current state before retrying any step whose outcome was not confirmed.
tunnelConfig.invalidInput: Enter a valid Tunnel ID (letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens) and an API key without spaces.
tunnelConfig.saveFailed: Could not save configuration. Check write access to the local application data directory and retry.
extensions.title: Extensions & instructions
permissions.owner: Computer Use executes in Runner. These native probes and requests apply to Desktop only. macOS may assign permission to Runner or its responsible app; a Desktop grant does not prove Runner access.
permissions.restartHelp: Denial is respected. After changing permissions, restart the actual permission owner if macOS asks, then retry the Runner operation. Runner-only restart is available in Extensions.
permissions.error: Permission request unavailable. Check system privacy settings.
plugins.help: Register a trusted native Tool Plugin on this Runner. Saving does not launch it; restart Runner to apply. Existing registrations are never overwritten.
plugins.name: Display name
plugins.argsHelp: Use an array of strings, such as ["/absolute/path/plugin.js"]. Arguments clear after submission. Use configuration profiles for credentials.
plugins.invalidArgs: Enter a JSON array containing only strings.
tunnelConfig.applyFailed: Configuration saved, but the Tunnel needs recovery. Retry the connection; Server and Runner were not restarted.
tray.hideDockIcon: Hide Dock icon when window is closed
setup.initialProjectHelp: You can add folders later in Projects.
setup.serverUrlLoopback: Use a Server address reachable from this computer. A loopback address points back to this computer.
setup.serverUrlOpenai: Enter your WebCodex Server address, not an OpenAI API or Tunnel address.
setup.serverUrlInvalid: Enter an http(s) Server origin without credentials, a path, query, or fragment.
setup.runnerNameHelp: A label to recognize this computer in ChatGPT. Up to 200 characters; the Runner ID stays unchanged.
setup.runnerNameInvalid: Use at most 200 characters without NUL.
completion.title: WebCodex is set up
setup.geminiRemote: Set up Gemini in Desktop on the computer running your WebCodex Server, or ask its owner for the MCP address to add in Gemini. This computer uses the remote connection.
setup.stopSharing: Stop Quick Share when you are ready to set up a lasting Gemini connection.
setup.geminiRunner: Gemini needs a local Runner registered to the Server owner. In Runtime settings, open the computer setup options and enable work on this computer.
setup.geminiPrepare: Set up WebCodex on this computer to connect Gemini.
migration.title: Existing local WebCodex found
migration.help: Save the current local setup to reuse your Server, projects, and ChatGPT connections so ChatGPT and Gemini can run together. Desktop will first check your running processes and project list.
migration.impact: Applying this change stops the Desktop-managed processes and hands them over to background services. Connections may drop briefly. Setup reuses saved credentials. New services start at sign-in by default.
migration.resume: An earlier migration is unfinished. Continue from its saved recovery record and startup settings. Services may stop or restart briefly during recovery.
migration.runnerOwner: Desktop cannot confirm ownership of the running Runner. Check which application started it and reconnect the original Runner in Desktop before retrying.
migration.serverOwner: Desktop cannot confirm ownership of the local Server. Identify its service manager and restore the original Desktop-managed Server before retrying.
migration.inventory: Reconnect the original Runner and check that its full project list is visible before retrying.
migration.jobs: Wait for queued and running jobs to finish. Retry when the original Runner reports no active work.
migration.layout: Restore a readable backup of the original Runner configuration and verify its identity and project registry before retrying. See Details for the compatibility issue.
migration.projectRegistry: Check that each saved project folder still exists and matches the Runner's project registry, then retry.
migration.tunnelCredentials: Check your saved ChatGPT Tunnel ID and API key in Connections, then retry.
migration.resetAvailable: An earlier migration did not finish and left no installed background services. Clear that unfinished record and check your setup again.
migration.genericError: Desktop could not verify the existing setup. Expand Details below or open Troubleshooting before retrying.
migration.recovery: Review the saved configuration and service owners in Diagnostics. Restore the original configuration if required, then return here.
migration.changed: Check the original Server address, Runner identity and project folder, then check this setup again.
migration.tunnelStartup: Check the saved connections. Start those set to start automatically and stop manual-only connections before retrying.
completion.runtimeRead: Try a read-only check in ChatGPT
completion.runtimePrompt: Use the connected WebCodex app to check Runtime status for Runner {{runner}} and list its available Projects. Do not create a Project, edit files or run commands.
completion.runtimeConfirm: I saw the Runtime status in ChatGPT
completion.runtimeReported: You reported a successful Runtime check. This is your confirmation, not an automatically observed connection test.
completion.read: Try reading a file in ChatGPT
completion.prompt: Use the connected WebCodex app. Find Runner {{runner}} and Project {{project}}. List its files, then read one small text file that I choose. Show its actual contents. Do not edit files or run commands.
completion.projectNeeded: Add a Project in Projects to try a file read. Your Runner can stay connected without a Project.
completion.noRunner: This computer has no local Runner. Choose an authorized Runner and Project in ChatGPT to try a read.
completion.confirm: I saw the file contents in ChatGPT
completion.reported: You reported a successful read. This is your confirmation, not an automatically observed connection test.
completion.identityPending: Runner identity is not available yet. Refresh the environment before trying the read.
tray.computerPausing: Computer: pausing; control still in flight
tray.computerPauseNotSaved: Computer: further input blocked; pause not saved; restart may enable control
error.serverPortTitle: Server could not start: local listen port is already in use
error.serverPortAction: Check whether another WebCodex Server or local program is already using that address, or open Diagnostics before retrying.
error.serverRequestAction: Verify the setup inputs, account configuration, or project settings for this stage, then open Diagnostics to check details.
error.serverBusyTitle: Server is temporarily unavailable or still starting
error.serverBusyAction: Wait a moment for the Server to finish starting, then refresh status.
error.serverConflictTitle: Server reported an existing or conflicting resource
error.serverConflictAction: Inspect the current Server state before retrying; avoid repeating side-effecting writes blindly.
error.serverInternalAction: Open Diagnostics or Activity to inspect the failed stage and Server status before retrying.
error.runnerConnectingTitle: Runner is disconnected and waiting to reconnect
error.runnerConnectingAction: Wait for the Runner to reconnect automatically, or inspect local Runner service status if it stays offline.
error.ownershipTitle: Cannot confirm local service or process ownership
error.ownershipAction: Inspect the existing installation or service owner first. Desktop will not forcefully take over or terminate unverified services.
error.serviceManagementAction: Check local service status, permissions, and Diagnostics before retrying.
error.serviceCredentialTitle: Local service account credential needs repair
error.serviceCredentialAction: Open Runtime & Services settings and repair the service account credential through the native OS prompt.
error.elevationTitle: Administrator permission is required or was cancelled
error.elevationAction: Approve the system elevation prompt when managing system-level services, or use a user-scoped service in Runtime settings.
error.migrationAction: Inspect both the previous and target installations before resuming migration. Desktop will not overwrite or delete legacy files automatically.
error.tunnelNetworkTitle: Tunnel connection could not reach the Server or network
error.tunnelNetworkAction: Check local Server availability, proxy settings, and network connectivity, then recheck this connection.
error.tunnelCredentialTitle: Tunnel credentials are missing or invalid
error.tunnelCredentialAction: Check and update the Tunnel ID, API key, or Tunnel token in Connections.
error.tunnelServerOwnedTitle: Server restart or explicit Server control is required for this connection
error.tunnelServerOwnedAction: Review active work and explicitly restart or manage WebCodex Server in Runtime & Services.
error.revisionStaleTitle: Configuration or state changed before the action completed
error.revisionStaleAction: Refresh to load the latest verified state, then review and apply the change again.
error.configCorruptAction: Open Diagnostics to inspect the configuration issue or explicitly restore the last known-good backup.
error.credentialRepairFailedTitle: Could not confirm the login credential was updated
error.credentialRepairFailedAction: Check the current login status in Diagnostics before deciding whether to submit a credential again.
error.authTitle: Login or API credentials are missing or invalid
error.authAction: Restore or re-authorize the user credential in Diagnostics or Connections, then refresh.
error.permissionTitle: Current account does not have permission for this action
error.permissionAction: Verify the account permissions and identity on the WebCodex Server before retrying.
error.uncertainTitle: Operation outcome could not be confirmed
error.uncertainAction: Observe the current runtime state before taking action. Desktop will not automatically replay an unconfirmed write.
error.ipcAction: Refresh state or reopen the view. If the issue persists, check Activity or restart Desktop.
error.unknownAction: There is not enough verified information to diagnose this automatically. Open Diagnostics or Activity to inspect safe status details.
error.confirmationTitle: Explicit confirmation is required before continuing
error.confirmationAction: Review active work and current state, then confirm the requested change explicitly.
error.diag.retryBlocked: Automatic retry is disabled until the actual state is verified.
